South Korea has proposed military talks with North Korea to resolve disagreements about where their border lies and prevent accidental clashes, seeking to ease tensions after recent landmine blasts injured three South Korean soldiers.

Read more: https://t.co/vuon6N4df6

Mark Zuckerberg made a deal with Meta's board to help him pay a proposed California tax on billionaires without losing his ownership stake in the company he founded, according to regulatory filings published this week.

Read more: https://t.co/rRk1xHtQjy

The chief of New Zealand's military, Air Marshal Tony Davies, resigned Friday after admitting to an inappropriate relationship as a unit leader.

He didn't elaborate on the circumstances of the relationship or when it happened.
